rootCause.boundary: The narrow shared function or state transition to repair

evidence.source: path#symbol, runtime log, or reproducible seed
evidence.observation: Observed evidence that proves the cause

evidence.behavior: Prefab, animation, audio, material, and serialized binding contract
evidence.adaptation: Use the imported local resource without an external-project fallback

serverDataCheck.rawResponse: path to captured response, debug HTTP output, or deterministic fixture
serverDataCheck.contract: Validated board/frame/state contract and expected dimensions/indexing; raw server symbol/layout fields are authoritative and immutable

evidence.source: runner README/spec, raw response, fixture, or mapper path
evidence.observation: Observed value and the contract comparison

evidence: The request does not directly modify Reel behavior

constraints: Infer original behavior primarily from target-local doc/js_scripts and game resource files; cite relevant script symbols and resource bindings
Do not use competitor URLs, live competitor sampling, or external competitor screenshots as visual acceptance gates

Treat target-project doc/**/*.png files as optional competitor-style references only; missing, unreadable, or insufficient PNGs never block, trigger an exit status, satisfy required evidence, or prove runtime visual acceptance

When Cocos MCP evidence is needed, derive the endpoint from the target project's funplay-cocos-mcp.config.json host and port; do not guess a default or reuse another project's endpoint, and verify returned project identity before treating MCP output as runtime evidence
Require at least one resource behavior evidence item; add legacy-script evidence only when the plan relies on archived JavaScript; project-info is metadata only
Use replicationId and metadataGameId as separate fields; never emit legacy localReference.gameId
Keep path-like serverDataCheck artifacts target-project-relative and free of reparse points or external locators
Treat raw server symbol/layout data as immutable; allow only contract-defined lossless decoding and presentation mapping
Derive the target project and taskId from <project>/doc/s_cli/<task-id>/plan.json
Ignore external-project fields in project_info and do not follow competitorUrl for additional evidence
Probe CC3Proj/{replicationId}_UI as an optional read-only original-project source; when absent, record NOT_FOUND_IGNORED and continue
Do not modify files outside affectedFiles
acceptance: Target-client runtime behavior matches the expected logic derived from local JS and resources; record runtime evidence separately from static validation
Mapped/runtime symbol and layout values match the accepted raw server response without semantic mutation, synthesis, reorder, padding, truncation, or substitution
No files outside affectedFiles are modified
stopConditions: Required target-local resource/script/project-info or server-contract evidence is missing or contradicted
